source: hash-computed by local Claude and verified in Live 12.4.16 (probe racks), 2026-11-08; sections by LiveBridge
id_rule: VST3 ParamID = JUCE String::hashCode(Surge storage name) & 0x7fffffff
missing_note: 2080 'MIDI CC ch|cc' proxies left out on purpose
notes: Surge XT. Names: A/B = scene; 'LFO 1-6' are the voice LFOs, 'Scene LFO 1-6' the scene LFOs (in patch files lfo0-5 and lfo6-11). FX slots: A1-A4 and B1-B4 are the scene inserts, S1-S4 the sends, G1-G4 global; 'FX A1 Param 1' is the first control of that slot's effect (what it does depends on the FX type).
Macros show as 'M1: -'..'M8: -' until the patch names them ('M1: Cutoff'): the name in Live changes with the patch.

Modulation routings, step sequences and MSEGs are not host parameters: write them into a patch with live_surge_write (routings, step_sequences) and load its .vstpreset with live_plugin_expose(preset_file=...).
VST3 ids are hashes of Surge's storage names (id_rule); 2080 'MIDI CC' proxy parameters are left out. 'Bypass Surge XT' is not mapped.
